summary_1line: Enraged over Rama’s exile, Shatrughna confronts and violently seizes the scheming hunchback Manthara, whom the palace guards blame for the king’s death.

image_candidates.scene_text: Prince Shatrughna angrily seizes the jeweled hunchback Manthara in the palace hall as frightened women scatter in every direction.
Manthara, hunched yet richly adorned with gems and sandalwood paste, is dragged forward by palace guards before the furious prince.
